title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03

ai_review.summary: Handheld audience recording with fair sound captures a high‑energy, smoking Scarlet > Fire/Not Fade Away and an electrifying China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its intense energy – highlights include a scorching Scarlet Begonias into Fire on the Mountain sequence, a crowd‑singing Not Fade Away, and a buzzing China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider. Recording quality is uneven; captured with a hand‑held tape recorder it’s clear enough to convey the vibe but suffers from limited fidelity and occasional muddiness.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently praise the musical performance while noting recording limitations; weighted average yields a strong show rating with decent but not stellar audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hand‑held tape recorder, limited clarity and some muddiness, but captures crowd energy; occasional dropouts noted.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy first and second sets with strong transitions, especially around the Scarlet/Fire segment; a psychedelic undercurrent runs throughout.
